        Four Superstars do battle until one Superstar

        Players can set up the name of the event,
        date, location, number of matches, and the
        match types.

        It is possible to recreate historic shows
        from the past, or create an original show.

        get the belt can leave the event with it.

        Two Superstars do battle to decide who is

        limit. A fall is scored when a competitor is
